title: David Campbell vs Smt. Shiphali Aayreen Campbell on 1 September, 2025

paragraphs.text:
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
 
 


Neutral Citation No. - 2025:AHC:153821
 

 
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD 
 
TRANSFER APPLICATION (CIVIL) No. - 894 of 2023 
 
 David Campbell 
 
 .....Applicant(s) 
 
 Versus 
 
 Smt. Shiphali Aayreen Campbell 
 
 .....Opposite Party(s) 
 
 
 
 
 
Counsel for Applicant(s) 
 
: 
 
Sanjay Mishra, Satya Prakash Pandey 
 
 
 
Counsel for Opposite Party(s) 
 
: 
 
Bhriguram Ji 
 
 
 
 Court No. - 37
 
 
 
 HON'BLE CHANDRA KUMAR RAI, J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant/ husband and Mr. Bhriguram Ji, leaned counsel for the opposite party/wife.

2. Brief facts of the case are that marriage of applicant was solemnized with opposite party according to Christian religion & rites on 30.1.2008. Two children were born on 9.8.2009 and 8.11.2012 out of wedlock of applicant and opposite party. Applicant filed a case for dissolution of marriage (divorce) under Section 10 of Divorce Act, 1869 before Principal Judge, Family Court, Jhansi. Opposite party/ wife has put in her appearance and filed her reply in the aforementioned divorce case filed by husband/ applicant. The aforementioned divorce case has been transferred from the Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Jhansi to the Court of Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Jhansi vide order dated 29.9.2023.
3. The instant transfer application has been filed in November, 2023 for the following reliefs:

"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to call for the records and to allow the present application and the proceedings of Case No.450 of 2021 (David Campbell vs. Smt. Shiphali Aayreen) pending in the Court of Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, District- Jhansi, under Section 10 of Divorce Act, 1869 may be transferred to some other Family Court from District- Jhansi such as Agra and Mathura etc. in the interest of justice.

It is further prayed that the further proceeding of Case No.450 of 2021 (David Campbell vs. Smt. Shiphali Aayreen) pending in the Court of Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, District- Jhansi under Section 10 of Divorce Act, 1869 may be stayed, during the pendency of the present application before this Hon'ble Court, and / or may pass such other and further orders which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case, otherwise, the applicant would suffer an irreparable loss and injury. "

4. Counsel for the applicant submitted that reasonable apprehension has arose in the mind of applicant that he will not get justice from the Family Court at Jhansi, as such, divorce petition filed by applicant at Jhansi should be transferred to Mathura or Arga. He further submitted that opposite party/ wife belong to very influential family, as such, he will not get justice from Family Court at Jhansi as well as applicant at present is residing at District- Ajmer, Rajasthan, as such, prayer for transfer made by applicant should be allowed. He further submitted that transfer application filed by applicant should be allowed and proceeding of divorce petition should be transferred from District- Jhansi to District- Mathura or Agra.

5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the opposite party submitted that the applicant/ husband himself has filed divorce petition at Family Court, Jhansi, as such, there is no question of transfer of divorce petition from Jhansi to Mathura or Agra. He further submitted that Principal Judge, Family Court, Jhansi vide order dated 29.9.2023 transferred the proceedings of Divorce Case No.450 of 2021 from the Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Jhansi to the Court of Additional Judge, Family Court, Jhansi, as such, further prayer of transfer of case no.450 of 2021 from Jhansi to Mathura or Agra is liable to be rejected.
6. I have considered the argument advanced by learned counsel for the parties and perused the records.
7. There is no dispute about the fact that the divorce case no.45 of 2021 filed by applicant / husband is pending in the Court of Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Jhansi.

8. It is material to mention that divorce case has been filed by applicant/ husband himself in the Family Court, Jhansi. It is also material to mention that on the application of applicant/ husband divorce case filed by applicant/ husband was transferred from the Court of Principal Judge, Family Court to the Court of Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Jhansi vide order dated 29.9.2023. The order dated 29.9.2023 is as under:
9. In view of the order dated 29.9.2023 as quoted above, the further prayer for transfer by husband/ applicant who himself filed the divorce case at Jhansi cannot be entertained.
10. Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, no interference is required in the matter.
11. The instant transfer application is rejected accordingly.
